author: Jayar
description: A virtual pet game for Discord. Adopt, care for, and nurture randomized animals through their lifecycle.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores user pet data, interaction history, achievements, and statistics.

short: Virtual pet game - adopt, care for, and raise pets!
